speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with yellowish skin; this condition is called jaundice. To determine the cause, have you noticed if the yellow color is spreading to your legs or arms, or does it seem limited to your face and chest?

speaker: Patient
text: 5-day-old male newborn. The newborn's mother reports that her child has developed yellowish discoloration of the skin that started from the face and then spread to the trunk since the past day. There have been no changes in his bowel habits or urination. The baby was born full-term at 38 weeks’ gestation via an uncomplicated vaginal delivery and has been exclusively breastfed every 2–3 hours.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (likely transitioning to Breast Milk Jaundice given the 5-day timeline).
REQUEST TEST: Total_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin, Hemoglobin, Reticulocyte_Count.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound if liver enlargement is suspected.
